subject: LAB-042
check: Desktop Native Power package contract qualification

outcome.detail: 24 tests in 3 suites passed. Menu alternatives, palette search, close without deleting documents, duplicate imports, App Intent adapter receipts, shell refusal, selected shell-like text treated as data, invalid text, model denial, cancellation, unavailable store, private scene restoration, reload, and preview-only reset passed through an in-memory OperationService.

limitations: Package fixture path on the development Mac, macOS 27.0 (26A425), Swift 6.4.0. No system menu, document scene, Services invocation, or file panel ran.
The allowlisted operation ran as the App Intent adapter, not through system intent parameter resolution or authentication.
No physical mobile device, manual assistive technology, or 26-SDK compile.
